rules.baseline_selection: Lowest validation MSE, then method name; no test-score selection
rules.encoding: 0.18*tanh(log1p(unit_count)/3) into fixed partitions of 128 sensory neurons
rules.feedback: No target, label, reward or readout feedback to either circuit
rules.inputs: Four latest all-unit count vectors, cumulative mean and causal EMA(alpha=0.25)
rules.metric: Mean squared error in log1p-count units; lower is better
rules.neural_time: 250 simulated ms per recorded 250 ms bin; continuous separate circuit per arm
rules.normalization: Train-only mean and scale; fixed ridge choices 0.01, 1, 100 selected on validation
rules.partition: Chronological 50% train / 25% validation / 25% test by target bin
rules.scope: One recorded organoid and short interval; no live tissue, human-brain simulation, general intelligence or biological-learning claim
rules.target: log1p of all-unit spike count in the next 250 ms bin
rules.units: All curated Units rows, in stored order; no activity-based selection
